reinforces.instructions: According to notes["{rating_id}"], did the presence of qualities["{quality_id}"] contribute to why the viewer {film_reaction} the film?

criteria.true: The viewer identifies the presence of the defined quality as a reason they felt that way about the film.
criteria.false: The viewer only mentions the quality, discusses its execution, or reacts to the quality differently from the film as a whole.

ruled_out.instructions: According to notes["{rating_id}"], did the viewer rule out qualities["{quality_id}"] as a factor in how they felt about the film?

criteria.true: The viewer says this defined quality did not affect how they felt about the film or that they did not experience it.
criteria.false: The note is silent about the quality, describes its execution, or identifies it as a reason for the overall reaction or an exception to it.

exception.instructions: According to notes["{rating_id}"], was the presence of qualities["{quality_id}"] an exception to how the viewer felt about the film, which they {film_reaction}?

criteria.true: The viewer disliked the presence of the defined quality in a film they liked, or liked its presence in a film they disliked.
criteria.false: The viewer merely mentions the quality, describes its execution alone, or singles out a different quality.

praises_execution.instructions: Does notes["{rating_id}"] praise how this film realised qualities["{quality_id}"]?

criteria.true: The viewer praises the specific way this film executed the defined quality.
criteria.false: The viewer praises the choice to include the quality, merely describes the execution, or praises a different quality.

criticises_execution.instructions: Does notes["{rating_id}"] criticise how this film realised qualities["{quality_id}"]?

criteria.true: The viewer criticises a specific aspect of how this film executed the defined quality.
criteria.false: The viewer criticises the underlying quality itself, merely describes the execution, or criticises a different quality.
